sealed_record.thesis: GlobalFoundries is modelled by the street as a stranded mature-node foundry with effectively zero AI exposure — that framing is now stale. aleabitoreddit's 19 Oct work names GFS as the reference-design laser platform for CPO/NPO, which puts it inside the one AI bottleneck that cannot be solved with money because laser capacity needs ~3 years of equipment investment to come online. Meanwhile pluggable makers have expanded from 2-3 suppliers to 5-7+ and Innolight is signing 2-3 year contracts to lock upstream capacity, so qualified Western photonics platforms get paid in volume before they get paid in price. The market is missing that a boring 'ex-growth' foundry sits in the silicon-photonics reference stack.

outcome.thesis_note: DITUTUP -12.4%. Ditutup dalam AI trade unwind: skandal dan pencopotan Jensen Huang (8 Nov), aturan sementara ekspor chip AI dari Departemen Perdagangan AS (16 Nov). Long AI/semikonduktor 0 dari 12 untung.
